blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — PNB Holdings Corp. has added creative agency RNDMD to the tenant roster of PNB Makati Center, lifting activity at its flagship office property along Ayala Avenue. On Thursday, the listed real estate holding company said on Thursday it had signed a lease agreement with RNDMD, which recently opened a creative studio in the building.
